## Required behavior and root reconciliation

The2C contract explicitly says an accessible deliberate choice survives roster changes at the same meaningful site, but **leaving that site or replacing the session resets context**. Today only `PanelView.refresh` compares `storageAnchor(state)`. `GameView.update` updates HUD alone, and closed-panel travel never invokes the comparison. Returning to the same endpoint anchor therefore revives the old destination; opening Notebook while away happens to reset it.

Move the existing cheap, non-rendering context observation behind one internal method and invoke it for ordinary GameView state updates even when panels are closed, as well as panel refresh/entry as needed. Preserve the exact stable semantic-anchor policy: pod/workshop bench and supported cradle are the same site; repairs or an accessible craft entering/leaving the roster must not alone erase valid intent. Do not replace it with rounded coordinates or a joined container roster. A real observed site departure resets From, explicit To and its obsolete local fallback notice; returning then computes the normal implicit default. Pausing, closing/reopening at the same site, changing panels or a same-site bench/cradle transition must not reset intent.

Keep existing validity fallback for inaccessible or source-equal destinations, normal command authority and truthful labels. No item/state mutation occurs until the player explicitly submits a valid command. Keep expansion/focus/inline-result/session reset behavior at its existing boundaries; a storage-context observation must not rebuild DOM, scroll, steal focus or change commands while merely observing travel. No unrelated notices or persistence changes beyond the separate save-retry fix.
